subject: Clearwater CU - resilience controls evidence and runbook walkthrough
messages:
From: Michael Green <m.green@clearwatercu.org>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearwatercu.org, Sara Liu <s.liu@clearwatercu.org>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Request: resilience control evidence and clarifications

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of Clearwater CU's vendor operational resilience review, our third-party risk team needs a focused evidence package to validate your claims on continuity, recoverability, and auditability. Could you provide the following items by the end of next week (July 17) if possible: 

- A mapping table showing Redwood controls to FFIEC-style requirements (availability, incident detection/response, change management, third-party dependencies).
- RTO / RPO targets for the hosted API and Dedicated deployments, with proof points (historical recovery exercises or test snapshots).
- An excerpt of your DR runbook that shows failover steps and roles (redacted for internal IPs is fine).
- SOC 2 summary page or report cover (non-sensitive), and details on log retention & audit log access for customer-facing incidents.
- Network segmentation diagram showing tenant separation and any customer-data isolation controls.
- Confirmation of disaster recovery test cadence and whether you allow customer-observed DR tests.

If a single zip would be easiest, that works; otherwise we can accept a shared Drive folder. Also please indicate any items that are not shareable and why (e.g., proprietary scripts, full SOC 2 report).

Appreciate it — can we set a 30-min walkthrough after you send the package? Sara from risk will join to ask a couple of clarifying questions.

Regards,
Michael Green
VP, Third-Party Risk
Clearwater Credit Union

Before we assemble the materials, two quick clarifications: 
1) Do you want the RTO/RPO split by deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private)?
2) For SOC 2, is a summary and the control mapping sufficient, or do you need a signed report copy (we can provide a redacted signed report under an NDA if required)?

Proposed walkthrough windows (ET): Tue 7/21 09:00–09:30, 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30.

I'll coordinate internally and share the evidence folder + a short resilience matrix. CCing Rishi and Priyom to pull the runbook excerpt and the topology figure.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Clearwater evidence request — need artifacts and redaction guidance

Team,

Forwarding Clearwater's ask (below). They want the mapping + runbook excerpt + topology + SOC2 summary by 7/17. We're committed to 7/17 but prefer to give a short package first and offer a follow-up for anything that needs more context.

Requests: 
- Rishi: can you pull the SOC 2 one-pager (scope/period) and the network topology annotated for tenant separation? Attach PNG.
- Priyom: can you extract the DR runbook excerpt that shows failover roles and the high-level failover steps (redact hostnames/IPs and internal ticket ids)? Put that in a text file with a header describing redactions.
- Marissa: can you review the resilience matrix spreadsheet once I draft it (we should map to FFIEC availability/resilience items and note whether evidence is attached or redacted).

Notes for redaction: replace hostnames with generic labels (app-node-1 -> app-node-A), remove internal SLAs not relevant to customer (e.g., internal ops runbooks for capacity). If anything is sensitive and cannot be shared, flag the reason (security, IP, NDA).

I'll draft an email to Clearwater and attach the initial package once we have those three artifacts.

Thanks — Priya

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clearwater evidence request — need artifacts and redaction guidance

Priya — thanks, pulling together now. Quick status: 
- Attached: redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf (one-pager: scope, last audit date, controls in-scope), network-topology-annotated.png (tenant/cluster boundaries highlighted).
- Priyom: I've created a redacted excerpt of the runbook and saved as dr-runbook-excerpt-2026.txt in the draft folder. It contains the failover checklist and the list of responsible roles (Ops Lead, Platform Eng, On-call SRE).

A few facts to call out for the customer email: 
- RTO/RPO: Hosted API (99th pct median response for recovery path) — RTO 15 minutes for control-plane failover, RPO < 5 minutes for standard customer state persisted in KV cache replication. Dedicated: RTO 1 hour for node replacement + auto-rebalance (dependent on reserved capacity agreement); Private: varies by customer ops, we provide runbook and assist with DR drills. 
- Disaster test cadence: quarterly tabletop, semi-annual partial failover tests, annual full DR exercise (we can provide test summaries for the last 12 months).

Redaction guidance: All hostnames replaced with {REDACTED-HOST-A/B}, internal ticket ids removed; do not share internal back-end performance traces or raw VM-level snapshots. Everything else is shareable under typical vendor review windows.

I'll attach the files to the shared Drive folder and mark the ones that are redacted. Let me know if you want me to include a short cover memo per file.

—Rishi
Director, Applied ML Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Package: Redwood resilience evidence for Clearwater CU (initial delivery)

Michael / Sara —

Attached is the initial evidence package for Clearwater CU's operational resilience review. We've provided a focused set of artifacts that map our controls to common FFIEC resilience expectations, plus redactions and context where appropriate. If you'd prefer a single zip, I'm happy to compress everything and re-send — we also uploaded the files to a shared Drive folder (link below).

Files included (attached / in Drive):
- redwood-resilience-matrix-CCU.xlsx — control mapping (column notes indicate whether supporting evidence is attached or redacted).
- redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf — SOC 2 scope & summary page. Full signed report available under NDA if required.
- network-topology-annotated.png — tenant boundaries and segmentation callouts.
- dr-runbook-excerpt-2026.txt — redacted runbook excerpt showing failover checklist and role assignments.

Key points: 
- RTO/RPO by deployment: Hosted API: RTO ~15 minutes for control-plane failover, RPO < 5 minutes; Dedicated: RTO ~1 hour depending on reserved capacity; Private: customer-specific (we provide guidance and can support observed tests).
- Test cadence: Quarterly tabletop, semi-annual partial, annual full exercise. Past test summaries (last 12 months) are available on request.
- Audit logs & retention: Application request logs retained for 90 days by default; full audit logs retained per contract terms (up to 1 year or longer on Dedicated/Private).

Next step: can we meet Tue 7/21 at 11:00–11:30 ET to walk through the matrix and answer any questions? Please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite.

Link to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-ccu-evidence
